Summit on Wireless Telecommunication Facilities within Palos Verdes Estates
Post Date: 09/09/2019 5:02 PM
Staff will be leading a community discussion and education summit regarding wireless telecommunication facilities at a special meeting on September 11th at 6:30 p.m., to be held at the Palos Verdes Golf Club. The goal is to get stakeholders including the wireless carriers, residents, the Art Jury and others together to discuss the issues raised by these facilities in our community. Everyone is encouraged to come and participate. The purpose of the meeting is for staff to get community input and to generate some ideas; the City Council will not be deliberating or taking any action at this meeting. Please tell your neighbors who might be interested in learning more about the issues and participating in developing a plan for the City.
If you were unable to attend, please click here for the video recording of the summit.
Questions? Contact:
Brianna Rindge, AICP
Planning Manager
